title: Squashage Refinement DSL
description: A .refine.json document that the RefinementApplier applies to a draft schema to produce a final blessed schema.

appliesTo.description: The className this refinement targets (must match the draft's x-squashage-class basename).

rename.description: JSON Pointer → new property name. Renames properties in the output schema.

promoteIri.description: JSON Pointer paths for properties to mark as IRI references (sets x-squashage-iri-promotion: true and format: 'iri').

closedEnum.description: Property names to mark as closed enums (x-squashage-closed-enum: true).

openVocabulary.description: Property names to mark as open vocabulary (x-squashage-open-vocab: true; removes any enum).

rdfsLabel.description: JSON Pointer to the property whose value is the rdfs:label (sets top-level x-squashage-rdfs-label).

rdfsComment.description: JSON Pointer to the property whose value is the rdfs:comment (sets top-level x-squashage-rdfs-comment).

range.description: Property name → range class name override (sets x-squashage-range on the property).

drop.description: Property paths to drop entirely from the schema.

subjectIriPolicy.description: Per-class subject-IRI override (consumed by SubjectIriPolicy.withOverride in Phase 2).

from.description: JSON Pointer into the record instance to read the candidate IRI value.

sanitize.description: Sanitize strategy applied to the resolved string.

fallback.description: JSON Pointer used when 'from' resolves to undefined.

arrayEnumIri.description: Array property name → range class name. For each element in the array, emits vocab:<arrayProp> vocab:<RangeClass>-<sanitize(value)>. Sets x-squashage-array-enum-iri at schema top level.

skolemSubject.description: Field name → sub-resource declaration. When the field is present, mints a skolem IRI at <subject>#<fragment>, asserts rdf:type vocab:<type>, and emits one data triple per declared property. Sets x-squashage-skolem-subject at schema top level.

fragment.description: IRI fragment appended to the subject IRI (e.g. 'actionCost').

type.description: vocab class name for the rdf:type assertion on the skolem subject.

properties.description: Declared data properties: propName → xsd type (string | integer | number | boolean).

provenanceIri.description: Emit a provenance triple using a standard vocabulary predicate. Sets x-squashage-provenance at schema top level.

from.description: JSON Pointer into the record to resolve the provenance URL value.

predicateOverride.description: Field name → override predicate IRI or curie. Replaces vocab:<fieldName> with the override predicate for that field's quad. Sets x-squashage-predicate-override at schema top level.

inverseOf.description: Forward property name → inverse property name. For every triple emitting vocab:<forwardProp> <object>, also emits <object> vocab:<inverseProp> <subject>. Sets x-squashage-inverse-of at schema top level.

parents.description: Parent class names. Each entry becomes an allOf: [{ $ref }] entry pointing at <parentsBase or derived base>/<ClassName>.schema.json.

parentsBase.description: Override the base URL used to build $ref paths for parent classes. When absent, derived from the draft's $id by stripping /inferred/<leaf>.
